foundation.name: Foundation
foundation.desc: Know what you earn, what you spend, and what you owe. Without this layer, everything below is guessing.

essentials.name: Essentials
essentials.desc: Cover the costs that produce or preserve income — these come before discretionary spending, savings, or debt acceleration.

safety.name: Initial Safety
safety.desc: A small cash buffer plus baseline insurance prevents predictable shocks from becoming financial catastrophes.

match.name: Free Money
match.desc: Capture any employer retirement match — an immediate 50–100% return that no investment can rival.

highdebt.name: High-Interest Debt
highdebt.desc: Eliminate debt whose interest rate exceeds your expected real return on investments. This is a guaranteed return equal to the rate.

fullef.name: Full Emergency Fund
fullef.desc: Build the operational reserve sized to your income stability so you can ride out genuine disruptions without forced selling or new debt.

taxcore.name: Tax-Advantaged Core
taxcore.desc: Fill the highest-leverage retirement vehicles in order of tax efficiency. The HSA is best where eligible.

goals.name: Goals & Moderate Debt
goals.desc: Fund medium-term goals and address moderate-interest debt where prepayment beats expected after-tax returns.

maxtax.name: Maximize Tax-Advantaged Space
maxtax.desc: Push toward the legal limits of tax-advantaged contributions before moving to taxable accounts.

advanced.name: Advanced Optimization
advanced.desc: Backdoor Roth, asset location, tax-loss harvesting, 529s, I-bonds. Compounding small edges over decades.

decumul.name: Decumulation Planning
decumul.desc: The withdrawal phase has different math than accumulation. Plan the exit before you need it.
